internal.title: Incident Report: Elevated Error Rates in Checkout Service
internal.body:
At 10:40 UTC on 2026-11-08, an alert was triggered for high error rates in the checkout service, with error rates reaching 9.5% and elevated p95 latency of 400 ms. Initial diagnosis indicated errors related to invalid payment tokens during checkout processing. Further investigation considered the payment service as a potential cause due to its elevated error rates (10-12%) and latency, but no conclusive evidence was found to confirm this.

The incident was escalated for deeper analysis. Multiple diagnosis rounds were conducted, with some proposed remediation plans rejected due to deployment constraints. The root cause remains under investigation, with the primary hypothesis focusing on error injection related to invalid payment tokens in the checkout service.

Impact: Customers experienced failures during checkout, likely due to invalid payment tokens causing transaction errors.

Next steps include continued monitoring and validation of payment token handling and error injection mechanisms in the checkout service.
